summary: 27-year-old Erie man lost the trail descending Mount Audubon ~8:04 p.m. and called 911; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group used a tracked UTV to reach Mitchell Lake Trailhead, hiked to him on foot, and transported him to the Brainard Lake winter parking lot uninjured; ~4.5-hr rescue (BCSO case 21-1145).
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; American Medical Response
